sentences.text: Mr. Dnyaneshwar A. Bide, Advocate for the Applicants.
Smt. Chaitali Choudhari-Kutti, Agp for Respondent/State.

Mr. Ramdas B. Singare, Advocate for Respondent No. 1.
 With
 Civil Application No. 9343 Of 2023
 In Fast/17412/2023
 Coram : Kishore C. Sant, J.
Date : 06th October, 2025.

Per Court :-
1.
The appeal is filed by the acquiring body.
In the appeal, the appellant has deposited the amount as per the impugned judgment and award.

The application is, therefore,
filed for withdrawal of the amount.
2. The learned advocate Mr. Bide for the applicant submits that, the applicant is entitled to compensation pursuant to the award.
He thus prays for withdrawal of the amount.
It is submitted that the main question is now about the award under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act whether can be filed on the cause of action of compromise decree passed in Lok Adalat.
In the present case, reference under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act came to be filed by the present applicant on the basis of award in the Lok Adalat.

In view of the judgment in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority (NOIDA) Vs. Yunus and others reported in (2022)
G.M.I.D.C.Through The Executive ... vs Dagadu Magan Palhate And Anr on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173404166/
1 AIR SC 847 the Hon'ble Apex Court has considered the provisions of Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 and the provisions of section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act.

entities.text: New Okhla Industrial Development Authority (NOIDA) Vs. Yunus and others reported in (2022)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is held that, the compromise in the Lok Adalat with no reference can be filed on the basis of compromise in the Lok Adalat.
The learned advocate Mr. Bide vehemently submits that, this judgment is of 2022.
In the present case, the reference was decided prior to the said judgment.
This Court finds that the question requires to be decided in the appeal.
4. Record and proceeding is already received.
5. Considering above, place the first appeal for final hearing on board dated 13.11.2025.

P.S.B. ( KISHORE C. SANT, J. )
